The '''56th [[Writers Guild of America Award]]s''', given in 2004, honored the [[film]] and [[television]] best writers of 2003.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://awards.wga.org/awards/nominees-winners/2005-1996 |title=Writers Guild Awards Winners: 2005-1996 |work=wga.org |publisher=Writers Guild of America |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260217142826/https://awards.wga.org/awards/nominees-winners/2005-1996 |archive-date=2026-02-17 |access-date=2026-02-20 |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.imdb.com/event/ev0000710/2004/1/|title=Writers Guild of America, USA (2004)|website=IMDb|access-date=2026-02-20}}</ref>
